verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents role-based Shares that grant read access to users/roles and can restrict exposure to specific tables/views via include patterns, plus preset roles for tenant isolation — covering table-level RBAC for multi-tenant use. However, there is no evidence of column-level masking policies or row-level security filters, which the story explicitly requires. Missing for 10: column masking policies, row-level security/filtering, unified role hierarchy spanning column+row+table grants.
